Average task completion time

A configured operational measure of average elapsed time from a documented task start to successful completion. Choose whether the task includes waiting and human review; automated execution runtime can be shown as a separate measure.

Level 4Inspect the detail

A configured operational measure of average elapsed time from a documented task start to successful completion. Choose whether the task includes waiting and human review; automated execution runtime can be shown as a separate measure.

minutes / task

How we use it

We instrument timestamps in internal tools and workflow logs, then compare equivalent tasks before and after process changes. Distribution and queue time can reveal bottlenecks hidden by an average.

Transparent calculationTotal elapsed completion minutes for successful eligible tasks ÷ number of successful eligible tasks
total successful task minutes300
successful eligible tasks100

300 ÷ 100 = three elapsed minutes per successfully completed task.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Task type and complexity
  • Workflow or system version
  • Queue and execution stage

Questions we investigate

  • Which step dominates elapsed completion time?
  • Are failed tasks excluded but tracked separately?
  • Did task complexity or workload mix change?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Instrument task boundaries consistently.
  • Inspect bottlenecks and review effort.
  • Compare completion time with quality and failure rates.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

Operations improvement lead
Weekly for comparable successful tasks.

Required data

  • Successful eligible task start and completion times
  • Task type, complexity, and workflow version
  • Elapsed-time and eligibility policy

Read the measure with context

Zero completed tasks makes the average undefined. Excluding failed or unfinished work creates selection bias; report those counts separately. Machine runtime differs from human effort. Parallel tasks and changes in task complexity can distort comparisons unless scope stays consistent.
